content.value: In the following figure, we can see a class hierarchy. If we add Amphibian animal or Omnivore animal in the class hierarchy, then many characteristics will be repeated in many classes and code should be changed frequently as number of classes will increase.
So, we want to distinguish between the various roles that animals play in their life and separate it for ease of use. Association is better rather than inheritance in this situation.
Which design pattern will solve this problem? Solve this problem with appropriate design pattern. Use required definitions and diagrams for explanation.
